reason: I already follow the Tawfeer and supermarket offers myself and stock up when there is a deal, and Jbeil is only 5 or 6 minutes by car. If I still have to go and collect the bag at their hour, in a pickup point, I save almost nothing and pay $2 for it.
objection: I'd still have to go and collect it, at their hour, not mine. And you pay what you paid at the till, so where is my saving, who checks the receipt, and why would I pay $2 a bag when I can drive to Spinneys myself?
would_change_my_mind: Home delivery, or a pickup point on my street with a longer window, plus proof on the receipt that I pay less than the shelf price on the deals I am already chasing.
